name: Infinite Terror
body:
School necromancy [emotion, fear, mind-affecting]; Level bard 5, death mage 6, inquisitor 6, shaman 6, sorcerer/wizard 6, witch 6
Duration 1 min./level; see tex.

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as the spell fear, except on a failed save, the affected creature is panicked and cowering for 1 minute or shaken for 1 round. At the beginning of the next minute the affected creature must make another Will save or be affected. This continues until the spell’s duration ends. A casting of remove fear or other spell or ability that removes a fear condition only removes the active condition, it does not remove the spell or the need to roll a Will save in the next minute.
